CustomField.description: This is the Model ChargeOff Probability pumped through a Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF). This shows how a charge-off score ranks compared to other charge-off scores. I.e., a charge-off score of .619 means that 61.9% of all submissions had a lower probability of charge-off. Similarly, a charge-off score of .05 means that only 5% of all submissions had a lower probability of charge-off.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The charge-off probability pumped through a CDF. This percentage tells you what proportion of submissions have a lower charge-off probability than this one.
CustomField.label: Model ChargeOff Score
